old_caption: The video captures a serene nighttime scene dominated by a single street lamp. The lamp, positioned centrally in the frame, emits a warm, yellowish glow that contrasts sharply with the surrounding darkness. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing solely on the lamp. There are no visible characters or animals present, and the environment is quiet and undisturbed, emphasizing the peacefulness of the night.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene nighttime scene dominated by a single street lamp. The lamp, positioned centrally in the frame, emits a warm, yellowish glow that contrasts sharply with the surrounding darkness. The light casts a soft illumination on the immediate vicinity, highlighting the gentle rain that falls steadily from above. The raindrops create a shimmering effect against the dark backdrop, adding a sense of tranquility to the scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing solely on the lamp and the falling rain. There are no visible characters or animals present, and the environment is quiet and undisturbed, emphasizing the peacefulness of the night. The consistent lighting and the rhythmic sound of rain create a calming atmosphere, inviting viewers to appreciate the simple beauty of a rainy night under a solitary street lamp.
caption: The video captures a near-black nighttime frame dominated by a single bright light fixture positioned in the upper-center-right. The fixture shows two glowing white trapezoidal panels side by side, topped by a warm orange halo. A faint vertical streak of dim light extends downward from the panels, while the surrounding area remains essentially pure darkness. A tiny reddish speck is visible far to the left, and no additional objects enter or leave the frame. The light fixture and the red speck hold the same positions from the first to the last visible frame. The two white panels and the orange halo keep a constant size, shape, and brightness throughout the excerpt. The faint streak below the light varies only slightly in visibility and texture during the excerpt, without producing any larger change.

This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.
Do not shorten a rich caption into a terse technical checklist. Avoid annotation phrases such as
'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.

must actually correct the cited issue. This is a fallible automatic review, not proof of correctness.
